title: Grateful Dead Live at Manor Downs on 1982-07-31
lineage: SBD > Cassette Master > DAT (44.1khz) > Sony R500 > SEK'D Prodif Plus > Samplitude Professional v7.02 > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy 1982 Manor Downs show captured on a solid soundboard mix, with smoking Candyman, Fire On The Mountain and a soaring Dew.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the tight, high‑bouncing playing and the fire that lit the night before Jerry’s 40th birthday. The setlist flows beautifully from an explosive first set (Candyman, Brown Eyed Woman, Deal) into a second half packed with long jams – Fire On The Mountain, Scarlet Begonias, Estimated→Eyes and a dramatic Dew. The soundboard recording is generally clear and well‑balanced, though occasional static on Uncle John’s Band and heat‑induced buzz are noted.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 4‑5 star reviews praise both the performance (tight, energetic, standout jams) and the recording (clear mix, well balanced), with only minor technical glitches.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and balanced mix; praised as superb by several reviewers. Minor issues include static on Uncle John’s Band, occasional buzzing due to heat, and a brief loss of signal, but overall the recording is very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid first set with tight grooves, followed by a second set that builds momentum with long jams and seamless segues (notably UJB → Truckin').

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as being in top form – crisp guitar work, strong vocals (especially on Candyman) and a birthday‑night fire.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboards add vocal harmonies on Candyman; overall keyboard presence praised as solid.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann and Mickey Hart lauded for an extra‑step performance, sounding like one drummer with eight arms.
